## How we are changing the future of health together

Since the American Heart Association’s founding in 1924, deaths from cardiovascular diseases have
been cut in half. And yet, there are still so many lives to be saved. By driving breakthroughs in
science, policy and care, together we can continue to advance health and transform lives every day.
**19 Million+**
**High blood pressure patients helped**
Our high blood pressure quality care initiative ensures lifesaving care for people at risk for heart
disease.
**$6 Billion+**
**Invested in pioneering research leading to lifesaving breakthroughs**
The American Heart Association is the largest non-profit, non-governmental funder of cardiovascular
and cerebrovascular research.
**22 Million**
**People trained in CPR every year**
9 out of 10 people who have a cardiac arrest outside of the hospital die. If performed immediately,
CPR can double or triple a person's chances of survival.
[ Learn more about our impact][16]
[7 hydration tips for July infographic]

## Summer Heat Can Sneak Up Before You Feel Thirsty

Hydration does more than help with thirst. It helps your heart pump blood and your body regulate
temperature. Before you spend time on the beach or in your backyard, know the simple signs to watch
for and how to stay ahead of the heat.

[ Keep this in mind before you head out in the heat][17]
[female doctor going over information with a female patient]

## NEW! 2026 Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic (CKM) Syndrome Guideline

Heart disease goes beyond the heart. Learn about the first ever guideline for managing CKM syndrome
including prevention, screening, and care across the overlapping cardiovascular, kidney and
metabolic risk factors.

[ Learn more about the new CKM guideline][18]
[ CKM Syndrome Guideline for Healthcare Professionals][19]
[Woman sitting on couch at home using telehealth service on her phone]

## Make the Most out of Telehealth

Telehealth makes it easier to get the care you need for conditions like high blood pressure and
diabetes—without leaving home. We have new tips, tools, and trusted resources to help you feel
confident about using virtual care.

[ Learn more about the American Heart Association Center for Telehealth][20]
[Dr. Manesh Patel working in a lab with others]

## New American Heart Association president aims to close the gap between discovery and care

Manesh Patel’s signature curiosity and drive fuel his focus on closing the divide between discovery
and care.
[ Read more about Dr. Manesh Patel][21]

# Emergency Medicine Physicians

In early 2015, North Canton-based Emergency Medicine Physicians (EMP) entered into an agreement with
funding partner, Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe, to form USACS, the national leader in
Physician-owned Integrated Acute Care. With the monumental market and regulatory shifts happening in
healthcare, forming USACS was the right move at the right time for the Physician group.

[ Contact Us arrow_forward_ios ][92]

## Becoming a World-Class Group

Now with the right capital partner, EMP has the necessary resources and experience to support growth
and ensure long-term future success. By joining a Physician-owned and led group with national scope,
EMP is better positioned to hire the best Physicians and Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) in the
country, expand its solution offerings, and compete directly with large, publicly-owned healthcare
groups.

 

#### Building a Strong Foundation

When it came time to develop the new USACS model, it was important for EMP to assemble a group that
shared its values of "[Servant’s Heart. Owner’s Mind."][93] – a mantra now guiding USACS. EMP sought
out other Physician groups with a commitment to Physician ownership and patient-centered care, now
known as the USACS founding partners.

 

#### Since Founding USACS

In the time since founding USACS, EMP’s [PhysicianFirst][94] Emergency Department management system
has grown to reach a national audience and serve the needs of many USACS hospital partners.
Additionally, the [Patient Satisfaction Academy][95] and [Scholars Programs][96] have been leveraged
to deliver meaningful education and training for Physicians and APPs throughout the company.

# Emergency Medicine Physicians

In early 2015, North Canton-based Emergency Medicine Physicians (EMP) entered into an agreement with
funding partner, Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe, to form USACS, the national leader in
Physician-owned Integrated Acute Care. With the monumental market and regulatory shifts happening in
healthcare, forming USACS was the right move at the right time for the Physician group.

[ Contact Us arrow_forward_ios ][92]

## Becoming a World-Class Group

Now with the right capital partner, EMP has the necessary resources and experience to support growth
and ensure long-term future success. By joining a Physician-owned and led group with national scope,
EMP is better positioned to hire the best Physicians and Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) in the
country, expand its solution offerings, and compete directly with large, publicly-owned healthcare
groups.

 

#### Building a Strong Foundation

When it came time to develop the new USACS model, it was important for EMP to assemble a group that
shared its values of "[Servant’s Heart. Owner’s Mind."][93] – a mantra now guiding USACS. EMP sought
out other Physician groups with a commitment to Physician ownership and patient-centered care, now
known as the USACS founding partners.

 

#### Since Founding USACS

In the time since founding USACS, EMP’s [PhysicianFirst][94] Emergency Department management system
has grown to reach a national audience and serve the needs of many USACS hospital partners.
Additionally, the [Patient Satisfaction Academy][95] and [Scholars Programs][96] have been leveraged
to deliver meaningful education and training for Physicians and APPs throughout the company.

[EMP logo]

> "The creation of USACS provides us with a great opportunity to grow our practice and strengthen
> our values of high quality patient care and Physician ownership."

# Emergency Care

## Together, we help save lives

Our integrated device and data system enable emergency medical response teams and communities to act
decisively, whether in the field or hospital setting. 

[Connect with an expert][58]
[X][59]

*Solutions* *Products* *Connect*
[ [Two EMTs pushing a Power-PRO 2 and holding a LUCAS device and LIFEPAK 35 monitor/defibrillator]
][60]

### Emergency medical service

You work in a demanding, fast-paced environment. You need durable, powerful, connected devices to
help save lives and coordinate teams to deliver the highest quality of care.

[Solutions for EMS and military][61]
[ [Doctos using a LUCAS v3, 3.1 device and LIFEPAK 35 monitor/defibrillator in the hospital] ][62]

### Hospitals

Equipment you can depend on in that moment when saving a life is the only thing that matters.
Intelligent tools monitor, document and review each code event to enhance response the next time.

[Solutions for hospitals][63]
[ [Bystander retrieving a LIFEPAK CR2 defibrillator for a sudden cardiac arrest victim] ][64]

### Workplace and public safety

Sudden cardiac arrest (SCA) knows no boundaries. Our products and solutions can provide a critical
resource to help an EMS first responder—a colleague, a teacher or simply a passerby—save a life.

[Solutions for public safety][65]

  

[ [Emergency care digital healthcare solutions] ][66]

collaborate and generate insights that help you drive improvements in protocols today—and team
performance for tomorrow.

[Digital healthcare solutions][67]

download.

education.

### Produkte und Services

#### Unser Leistungsportfolio

### Mobile Geräte

Entwicklung smarter Geräte & Anwendungen für alle Branchen mit Schwerpunkt im Industrie- und
Logistikbereich.

[Leistungsportfolio mobile Geräte/Mobile Solutions]

### EMS

Hochpräzise Elektronikfertigung, kundenspezifische Prüftechnologien, Geräteendmontagen und
Kabelkonfektionierung.

[Leistungsportfolio EMS und Kabelproduktion/Manufacturing]

### Antriebstechnik

Entwicklung maßgeschneiderter Antriebs- und I/O-Systeme sowie Power Supplies für den Maschinenbau
und industrielle Anwendungen.

[Leistungsportfolio Antriebstechnik/Motion Systems][Leistungsportfolio Antriebstechnik/Motion
Systems]

### Leistungsbereiche

#### Branchen der ACD Gruppe

Mit unserem umfangreichen Produkt- und Leistungsportfolio bedienen wir die folgenden Branchen:

### Industrie

ACD liefert elektronische Systeme, Baugruppen, mobile Geräte und HMIs für die Industrie und
unterstützt Bedienung, Überwachung und Optimierung von Produktionsprozessen.

[Industrie][Industrie]

### Logistik

Unsere mobilen Geräte sind für raue Umgebungen konzipiert und tragen zur Effizienzsteigerung und
Prozessoptimierung in Lager- und Transportabläufen.

[Branche Logistik][Branche Logistik]

### Medizintechnik

Mit der ISO 13485-Zulassung ist ACD Partner für die Entwicklung und Fertigung von elektronischen
Systemen, Baugruppen und kundenspezifischen Geräten im Medizinbereich.

[Branche Medizintechnik][Branche Medizintechnik]

### Sicherheitstechnik

Unternehmen aus der Sicherheitsbranche vertrauen auf unsere kundenspezifischen Geräte, Steuerungen
und elektronischen Systeme für höchste Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit.

[Branche Sicherheitstechnik][Branche Sicherheitstechnik]

### Defense

Ihr Partner für die kundenindividuelle Entwicklung und Fertigung von elektronischen Systemen,
Baugruppen, Steuerungen und Bediengeräten für die Verteidigungsbranche.

[Defense][Defense]

### Retail

Seit 1982 liefert ACD mobile Geräte und maßgeschneiderte elektronische Lösungen für den Handel.
Unsere Produkte überzeugen durch Zuverlässigkeit, Langlebigkeit und einfache Integration.

[Retail][Retail]

### Leitbild

#### Über unser Unternehmen

Die ACD Gruppe ist eine inhabergeführte Unternehmensgruppe und zuverlässiger Partner für mobile
Geräte und Anwendungen, Elektronikfertigung, Gerätemontagen, Kabelkonfektionierung und
Antriebstechnik.

Mit fünf spezialisierten Tochtergesellschaften an Standorten in Deutschland, Tschechien und den USA
entwickeln und fertigen wir innovative und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für verschiedenste Branchen.

[Mehr erfahren][66]
[acd gruppe standorte uebersicht][acd gruppe standorte uebersicht]

### Produkte und Services

#### Unser Leistungsportfolio

### Mobile Geräte

Entwicklung smarter Geräte & Anwendungen für alle Branchen mit Schwerpunkt im Industrie- und
Logistikbereich.

[Leistungsportfolio mobile Geräte/Mobile Solutions]

### EMS

Hochpräzise Elektronikfertigung, kundenspezifische Prüftechnologien, Geräteendmontagen und
Kabelkonfektionierung.

[Leistungsportfolio EMS und Kabelproduktion/Manufacturing]

### Antriebstechnik

Entwicklung maßgeschneiderter Antriebs- und I/O-Systeme sowie Power Supplies für den Maschinenbau
und industrielle Anwendungen.

[Leistungsportfolio Antriebstechnik/Motion Systems][Leistungsportfolio Antriebstechnik/Motion
Systems]

### Leistungsbereiche

#### Branchen der ACD Gruppe

Mit unserem umfangreichen Produkt- und Leistungsportfolio bedienen wir die folgenden Branchen:

### Industrie

ACD liefert elektronische Systeme, Baugruppen, mobile Geräte und HMIs für die Industrie und
unterstützt Bedienung, Überwachung und Optimierung von Produktionsprozessen.

[Industrie][Industrie]

### Logistik

Unsere mobilen Geräte sind für raue Umgebungen konzipiert und tragen zur Effizienzsteigerung und
Prozessoptimierung in Lager- und Transportabläufen.

[Branche Logistik][Branche Logistik]

### Medizintechnik

Mit der ISO 13485-Zulassung ist ACD Partner für die Entwicklung und Fertigung von elektronischen
Systemen, Baugruppen und kundenspezifischen Geräten im Medizinbereich.

[Branche Medizintechnik][Branche Medizintechnik]

### Sicherheitstechnik

Unternehmen aus der Sicherheitsbranche vertrauen auf unsere kundenspezifischen Geräte, Steuerungen
und elektronischen Systeme für höchste Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit.

[Branche Sicherheitstechnik][Branche Sicherheitstechnik]

### Defense

Ihr Partner für die kundenindividuelle Entwicklung und Fertigung von elektronischen Systemen,
Baugruppen, Steuerungen und Bediengeräten für die Verteidigungsbranche.

[Defense][Defense]

### Retail

Seit 1982 liefert ACD mobile Geräte und maßgeschneiderte elektronische Lösungen für den Handel.
Unsere Produkte überzeugen durch Zuverlässigkeit, Langlebigkeit und einfache Integration.

[Retail][Retail]

### Leitbild

#### Über unser Unternehmen

Die ACD Gruppe ist eine inhabergeführte Unternehmensgruppe und zuverlässiger Partner für mobile
Geräte und Anwendungen, Elektronikfertigung, Gerätemontagen, Kabelkonfektionierung und
Antriebstechnik.

Mit fünf spezialisierten Tochtergesellschaften an Standorten in Deutschland, Tschechien und den USA
entwickeln und fertigen wir innovative und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für verschiedenste Branchen.

[Mehr erfahren][66]

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers

Ingredient (API) manufacturing company, has suc-cessfully commissioned a new ground-mounted

underscores its long-term commitment to sustainability and the expansion of renewable energy.

# CardiAngel for "Cardio-Protected Cities"

Intervention in the First 3 Minutes Connects to Life

The American Heart Association reports that Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrests (OHCA) cause more deaths
than colon cancer, breast cancer, prostate cancer, car accidents, pneumonia, respiratory infections,
HIV, firearms, and fires combined.

In an emergency, it typically takes 8-15 minutes for an ambulance to arrive at the scene in places
like buildings, schools, hotels, and homes. Each minute of delay reduces the chance of survival by
10%. If defibrillation starts late, the patient's chance of survival drops significantly, with only
1 in 250 patients surviving if cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) and defibrillation begin after
the first 10 minutes.

A cardio-protected city isn't just about having AEDs available. It's about creating a community
vision where everyone works together to respond quickly to emergencies. With our expertise and
careful placement of AEDs based on access needs, we can help build "Heart Safe Cities."

[A smiling senior couple embracing outdoors under autumn trees, representing peace of mind and
safety. CardiAngel AED offers rapid, reliable support in sudden cardiac arrest situations, making
heart-safe living possible for every generation.]

Sudden cardiac arrest occurs when the heart stops beating suddenly for any reason, with or without
warning. One reason the heart might stop is the failure of the electrical system in the heart to
conduct impulses along the correct path. Random impulses firing all over the heart will cause it to
quiver uselessly, not moving blood around the body or producing a pulse.

When the AED shocks the heart it causes the heart to stop momentarily. This pause gives the heart
time to reset and allows special cells in the heart to regain control and fire rhythmically, pushing
blood.



People from any age, gender or race carry risk of sudden cardiac arrest; however some of them have
higher risk than others:

*   40+ years old males
*   Menopausal females
*   Smokers
*   Diabetics
*   Lack of exercise
*   Stress
*   High cholesterol
*   Cardiac diseases

Who carries risk of sudden cardiac arrest ?

What is Sudden Cardiac Arrest ?

[A close-up of a joyful family—mother, father, and children—smiling together, paired with an
awareness message about sudden cardiac arrest. This emotional image underlines the critical need for
CardiAngel AEDs in homes, schools, and public areas to provide immediate life-saving support during
cardiac emergencies.]

Every year, more than 7 million  people die to a sudden cardiac arrest, worldwide. A sudden cardiac
arrest can hit anyone, anywhere and at any time. A defibrillator in combination with well-performed
chest compressions is the only therapy that can save a patient’s life.

[A visual infographic featuring 10 human figures, with 9 in green and 1 in red, illustrating that 9
out of 10 people who experience cardiac arrest can survive if treated with an AED shock in the first
minute. The image underscores the critical role of rapid defibrillation using devices like
CardiAngel AED]
[A graph titled 'Survival Rate vs Time to Defibrillation' shows that survival chances drop from
approximately 90% to below 20% within 9 minutes after cardiac arrest. This powerful visualization
stresses the importance of having CardiAngel AED devices accessible for immediate response. Every
minute matters. Delaying defibrillation reduces survival by up to 10% per minute]

What's the difference between a heart attack and a cardiac arrest?

[A detailed anatomical illustration showing a human torso with a visible heart and superimposed ECG
tracings. The highlighted irregular rhythm represents a potentially fatal arrhythmia. CardiAngel AED
devices are designed to detect and correct such life-threatening heart rhythms immediately, helping
restore normal cardiac function]

While a heart attack is a circulation problem, cardiac arrest is an electrical problem triggered by
a disruption of the heart's rhythm.


During a heart attack, blood flow to the heart is blocked, often by a blood clot or a buildup of
plaque in the arteries. Since the heart muscle needs oxygen to survive, when blood flow is blocked,
the muscle begins to die. This is why heart attack sufferers need to be rushed into surgery to
resolve the obstruction and restore blood flow.

In cardiac arrest, the heart stops beating and needs to be restarted. Because cardiac arrest stops
the heart from beating, the brain, lungs, and other organs do not get the blood and oxygen they
need. Cardiac arrest can lead to death within minutes if not treated. Most heart attacks do not lead
to cardiac arrest. However, when cardiac arrest happens, a heart attack is a common cause.

EVERY MINUTE COUNTS

 

During a cardiac arrest, the survival probability

decreases by about 10 % every minute.

 

If the victim is unconscious and is not breathing normally, chest com-pressions and rescue breaths
(CPR) need to be performed immediately. CPR doubles the survival rate and the early use of an
Automated External Defibrillator (AED) can lead to survival rates of up to 75% in case of cardiac
arrests. In an emergency, procedures that would normally be easy to follow can be confusing.
CardiAngel therefore focuses on providing easy-to-use devices, enabling quick action during an
emergency.

Anyone. Anywhere. A Lifesaver

during sudden cardiac arrests. With its sleek and user-friendly design, CardiAngel® is crafted to

precious minutes until professional help arrives.

# CardiAngel for "Cardio-Protected Cities"

Intervention in the First 3 Minutes Connects to Life

The American Heart Association reports that Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrests (OHCA) cause more deaths
than colon cancer, breast cancer, prostate cancer, car accidents, pneumonia, respiratory infections,
HIV, firearms, and fires combined.

In an emergency, it typically takes 8-15 minutes for an ambulance to arrive at the scene in places
like buildings, schools, hotels, and homes. Each minute of delay reduces the chance of survival by
10%. If defibrillation starts late, the patient's chance of survival drops significantly, with only
1 in 250 patients surviving if cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) and defibrillation begin after
the first 10 minutes.

A cardio-protected city isn't just about having AEDs available. It's about creating a community
vision where everyone works together to respond quickly to emergencies. With our expertise and
careful placement of AEDs based on access needs, we can help build "Heart Safe Cities."

[A smiling senior couple embracing outdoors under autumn trees, representing peace of mind and
safety. CardiAngel AED offers rapid, reliable support in sudden cardiac arrest situations, making
heart-safe living possible for every generation.]

Sudden cardiac arrest occurs when the heart stops beating suddenly for any reason, with or without
warning. One reason the heart might stop is the failure of the electrical system in the heart to
conduct impulses along the correct path. Random impulses firing all over the heart will cause it to
quiver uselessly, not moving blood around the body or producing a pulse.

When the AED shocks the heart it causes the heart to stop momentarily. This pause gives the heart
time to reset and allows special cells in the heart to regain control and fire rhythmically, pushing
blood.



People from any age, gender or race carry risk of sudden cardiac arrest; however some of them have
higher risk than others:

*   40+ years old males
*   Menopausal females
*   Smokers
*   Diabetics
*   Lack of exercise
*   Stress
*   High cholesterol
*   Cardiac diseases

Who carries risk of sudden cardiac arrest ?

What is Sudden Cardiac Arrest ?

[A close-up of a joyful family—mother, father, and children—smiling together, paired with an
awareness message about sudden cardiac arrest. This emotional image underlines the critical need for
CardiAngel AEDs in homes, schools, and public areas to provide immediate life-saving support during
cardiac emergencies.]

Every year, more than 7 million  people die to a sudden cardiac arrest, worldwide. A sudden cardiac
arrest can hit anyone, anywhere and at any time. A defibrillator in combination with well-performed
chest compressions is the only therapy that can save a patient’s life.

[A visual infographic featuring 10 human figures, with 9 in green and 1 in red, illustrating that 9
out of 10 people who experience cardiac arrest can survive if treated with an AED shock in the first
minute. The image underscores the critical role of rapid defibrillation using devices like
CardiAngel AED]
[A graph titled 'Survival Rate vs Time to Defibrillation' shows that survival chances drop from
approximately 90% to below 20% within 9 minutes after cardiac arrest. This powerful visualization
stresses the importance of having CardiAngel AED devices accessible for immediate response. Every
minute matters. Delaying defibrillation reduces survival by up to 10% per minute]

What's the difference between a heart attack and a cardiac arrest?

[A detailed anatomical illustration showing a human torso with a visible heart and superimposed ECG
tracings. The highlighted irregular rhythm represents a potentially fatal arrhythmia. CardiAngel AED
devices are designed to detect and correct such life-threatening heart rhythms immediately, helping
restore normal cardiac function]

While a heart attack is a circulation problem, cardiac arrest is an electrical problem triggered by
a disruption of the heart's rhythm.


During a heart attack, blood flow to the heart is blocked, often by a blood clot or a buildup of
plaque in the arteries. Since the heart muscle needs oxygen to survive, when blood flow is blocked,
the muscle begins to die. This is why heart attack sufferers need to be rushed into surgery to
resolve the obstruction and restore blood flow.

In cardiac arrest, the heart stops beating and needs to be restarted. Because cardiac arrest stops
the heart from beating, the brain, lungs, and other organs do not get the blood and oxygen they
need. Cardiac arrest can lead to death within minutes if not treated. Most heart attacks do not lead
to cardiac arrest. However, when cardiac arrest happens, a heart attack is a common cause.

If the victim is unconscious and is not breathing normally, chest com-pressions and rescue breaths

Automated External Defibrillator (AED) can lead to survival rates of up to 75% in case of cardiac
arrests. In an emergency, procedures that would normally be easy to follow can be confusing.
CardiAngel therefore focuses on providing easy-to-use devices, enabling quick action during an
emergency.

### AHA Course Descriptions

**Basic Life Support (BLS)** This is a CPR Class for Healthcare Providers such as nurses, doctors,
dentists, dental hygienists, radiologists, paramedics, therapists, and all other healthcare and
medically related professions. This course is also known as BCLS or Basic Cardiac Life Support, and
it is the required course for healthcare providers. This course is for first time CPR students, as
well as a CPR renewal certification class.
**This Healthcare Provider CPR Class **Satisfies All Requirements for Healthcare Workers and
Students in Healthcare and Medically Related Programs**. This course is American Heart Association
certified and includes infant, child and adult CPR and AED training. At the end of the class you
will receive a 2 Year AHA BLS Provider Card. Register Now for the Best CPR Training Nashville has to
offer!

**Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS)** ACLS is an advanced American Heart Association course for
specialized health care providers such as surgeons, emergency medical physicians and nurses,
paramedics, respiratory therapists, and other medical professionals in life threatening and critical
environments. Managing airways, initiating IV’s, reading ECG’s, and understanding emergency
pharmacology is required.

**Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS)** PALS is an advanced life support course revolving around
a pediatric crisis. Specialized nurses, physicians, paramedics, and all other healthcare providers
who must develop and enhance their pediatric assessment skills need to be PALS certified. You will
learn and practice identifying the onset of shock, as well as respiratory and cardiovascular
emergencies in children and infants.

### Answers To Common Questions

**Q: Will I get my card the day of class? **

**A:** All students who successfully complete their CPR class Nashville, and have paid for their
training in full, will receive their card that day. If the student has an unpaid balance, their card
will be issued once the final payment has been received.


**Q: How long will my class be?**

**A:** Each student’s visit with CPR Nashville will vary in length depending on which class they
attend and how many students are enrolled. Please see the following for a list of estimated class
times. These times are subject to changed based on the above influencing factors.

BLS Renewal / BLS Class: ~ 4 hours
Heartsaver CPR AED Class: ~ 3 hours
Heartsaver CPR AED First Aid Class: ~ 6-7 hours
First time ACLS Class: ~ 10-12 hours (1 DAY ONLY!)
First time PALS Class: ~ 12-14 hours (1 DAY ONLY!!)
ACLS Renewal Class: ~ 6-8 hours
PALS Renewal Class: ~ 5-8 hours
BLS-ACLS Combo Class: ~ 8 hours


**Q: Which CPR class should I take?**

**A:** Please see the class descriptions to find out which class is best suited for your needs. If
you still have questions, or need further assistance, call us at 615-397-9316.
Our staff is available 7 days a week to assist you and answer your questions.

**Q: Are you an American Heart Association Training Site?**

**A:** We are an American Heart Association Training Site. All of our instructors are AHA certified
instructors with years of experience in healthcare and teaching. If you would like more information
about an American Heart Association CPR class at our training site, please call us. We are always
happy to answer questions and provide information.

**Q: Do I need to bring anything with me to class? **

**A: ** All students should bring their provider manual with them to class. Students should also
wear comfortable clothing. Each of our classes involves hands on training and practice so being
comfortable is important.

**Q: What areas around Nashville do students usually come from to take CPR courses? **

**A: ** Students come from all over the Tennessee surrounding areas including Franklin, Smyrna,
Brentwood, Green Hills, Spring Hill, Williamson, Murfreesboro, Bellevue, Hendersonville, Lebanon,
Gallatin, Mt. Juliet, and Forest Hills. We even have students come from as far as Kentucky and
Mississippi.

**Q: How long is my certification good for?**

**A:** Each of our American Heart Association classes provide a 2 year certification card upon
successful completion of the class. Students will have until the last day of the month when the card
is due to expire to renew their certification.

**Q: What if my certification card is expired?**

**A:** If your Heartsaver CPR or BLS certification is expired, it will not matter. We teach the same
BLS Class and Heartsaver Class to everyone. If you are expired in ACLS or PALS, certain rules apply
as to whether you can or cannot take the ACLS recertification class or the PALS recertification
class. Please visit our ACLS Renew page or the PALS Renew page for more detailed information about
these expired certifications. It will be in the “Who should take this class” section. If you still
have questions, please call us anytime and our staff will gladly guide you on which class to take.

**Q: What if you do not offer courses on dates or times that I can attend?**

**A:** Our training site offers private group classes. If you and a few others have a specific date
and time that you would like us to host a CPR class Nashville area, just give us a call. We provide
private classes at our training site and travel to all areas in and around Nashville for private
classes. Pricing for private classes will be based on how many students are in attendance. Private
classes are available for our Heartsaver CPR AED course, Heartsaver First Aid course, BLS healthcare
provider course, ACLS first time and ACLS recertification course, and PALS first time and PALS
recertification courses.

**Q: How do I register?**

**A:** Registration is Easy! Simply choose the class that you need to take from either our menu at
the top or click on the image of the training certification you need above. This could include a CPR
training class for healthcare providers, or a more advanced class such as ACLS or PALS. We also
offer HeartSaver CPR and First Aid for non-healthcare individuals. After you choose the course you
need, you will be taken to a page that includes further information about this certification as well
as a calendar. In the calendar you can simply click the link of the class that works best for your
schedule. At that point, you will be taken to a secure online registration form. It's that simple!

**If you have any questions, please call us at 615-397-9316 **
[American Heart Association CPR training in Nashville TN]

[[Student Reviews CPR Class][Student Reviews CPR Class]][33]




### AHA Course Descriptions

**Basic Life Support (BLS)** This is a CPR Class for Healthcare Providers such as nurses, doctors,
dentists, dental hygienists, radiologists, paramedics, therapists, and all other healthcare and
medically related professions. This course is also known as BCLS or Basic Cardiac Life Support, and
it is the required course for healthcare providers. This course is for first time CPR students, as
well as a CPR renewal certification class.
**This Healthcare Provider CPR Class **Satisfies All Requirements for Healthcare Workers and
Students in Healthcare and Medically Related Programs**. This course is American Heart Association
certified and includes infant, child and adult CPR and AED training. At the end of the class you
will receive a 2 Year AHA BLS Provider Card. Register Now for the Best CPR Training Nashville has to
offer!

**Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS)** ACLS is an advanced American Heart Association course for
specialized health care providers such as surgeons, emergency medical physicians and nurses,
paramedics, respiratory therapists, and other medical professionals in life threatening and critical
environments. Managing airways, initiating IV’s, reading ECG’s, and understanding emergency
pharmacology is required.

**Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS)** PALS is an advanced life support course revolving around
a pediatric crisis. Specialized nurses, physicians, paramedics, and all other healthcare providers
who must develop and enhance their pediatric assessment skills need to be PALS certified. You will
learn and practice identifying the onset of shock, as well as respiratory and cardiovascular
emergencies in children and infants.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

## Products & Applications

### Shaping the Future of Combination Devices

Our expertise extends across a wide range of device formats and materials. Whether your program
requires durability, bioresorbability, or unique geometries, ExtruPharm is positioned to deliver.

### Applications Include:
* Drug-eluting implants for sustained and long-acting release
* Parenteral and implantable devices for direct-to-target or systemic delivery
* Custom geometries including rods, tubes, films, co-extruded structures, and complex profiles
* Next-generation combination devices built with polymer science and process innovation at the core

### Materials We Work With:
* Bio-durable polymers such as EVA and TPU
* Bioresorbable polymers including PLA, PLGA, PCL, and more
* Customized material blends and advanced formulations

## Why Choose ExtruPharm

ExtruPharm is built around flexibility, technical depth, and cost-effectiveness. We are an ideal
partner for pharmaceutical and biotech companies seeking innovative solutions without unnecessary
overhead.

### Cost-Effective Development

Our rates are typically a fraction of larger CDMOs, allowing you to conserve budget for clinical
manufacturing.

You retain full ownership of your intellectual property. All work performed is yours to transfer,

Every process we design is built to be transferable — whether to a GMP CDMO of your choosing or to

### Agile & Responsive

As a small, specialized company, we move quickly, provide direct access to experts, and adapt to
your program’s unique needs.

From modifying processes to designing equipment, we go beyond off-the-shelf solutions to ensure your
project’s success

### Industry Connections

Our strong relationships with leading equipment and material suppliers give you access to the right
resources, at the right time.

## About ExtruPharm

ExtruPharm is a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) specializing in the
development of polymer-based drug delivery devices

Since 2018, we have been helping companies bring complex ideas to life through expertise in
extrusion technologies, injection molding, and custom device engineering. Our focus is on creating
drug-eluting implants, parenteral devices, and combination products that improve patient outcomes
through controlled drug release.

In 2025, ExtruPharm expanded into a new 5,500 sq. ft. R&D facility in Auburn, Massachusetts,
enabling us to deliver analytical support and scalable prototype manufacturing with seamless
pathways toward GMP production through tech transfer partnerships.

We work with clients of all sizes — from startups to established pharmaceutical companies and
Universities — to deliver innovative solutions that are flexible, cost-effective, and tailored to
your program’s needs.

Applying for a grant? ExtruPharm is ideally situated to help with flat-fee services to keep you in

 GDLS BRAND FILM

**We Serve Those Who Protect What Matters.**

A trusted partner of forces around the world, we deliver with agility, innovation and exceptional
customer support. Every day, our global team forges ahead into the next era of combat capability,
including autonomy-ready platforms, modern digital architecture and AI-enabled advantages.

That’s why Soldiers and Marines have trusted General Dynamics Land Systems products in the toughest
conditions for decades. We deliver the power to win.

[ Learn More ][36]

### ABOUT GDLS

General Dynamics Land Systems builds the combat vehicles and integrated technologies that give
soldiers a decisive advantage. We design, engineer and sustain advanced tracked and wheeled systems
paired with modern electronic architecture, AI-enabled capabilities and autonomy-ready technology.

From Abrams to LAV, Stryker to AJAX, robotic platforms to software solutions and beyond, our
portfolio delivers proven performance and future-ready modernization for customers around the world.

### Not a career.
### A calling.

Join the people who design, build and advance the systems that protect those who protect us. Our
teams see beyond the horizon, solving problems before they become challenges.

Bring your talent. Bring your purpose.

Let’s shape the future of General Dynamics Land Systems together.

**We Serve Those Who Protect What Matters.**

A trusted partner of forces around the world, we deliver with agility, innovation and exceptional
customer support. Every day, our global team forges ahead into the next era of combat capability,
including autonomy-ready platforms, modern digital architecture and AI-enabled advantages.

That’s why Soldiers and Marines have trusted General Dynamics Land Systems products in the toughest
conditions for decades. We deliver the power to win.

[ Learn More ][36]

### ABOUT GDLS

General Dynamics Land Systems builds the combat vehicles and integrated technologies that give
soldiers a decisive advantage. We design, engineer and sustain advanced tracked and wheeled systems
paired with modern electronic architecture, AI-enabled capabilities and autonomy-ready technology.

From Abrams to LAV, Stryker to AJAX, robotic platforms to software solutions and beyond, our
portfolio delivers proven performance and future-ready modernization for customers around the world.

### Not a career.
### A calling.

Join the people who design, build and advance the systems that protect those who protect us. Our
teams see beyond the horizon, solving problems before they become challenges.

Bring your talent. Bring your purpose.

Let’s shape the future of General Dynamics Land Systems together.

Greatness can only be achieved with a solid strategy. We create strategic value through a strong
vision and clear brand positioning to improve your competitive position and manage business risk.

launching a brand or refreshing your identity, we use design and storytelling to capture and excite
your audiences.

Our goal is to drive revenue and leads for you. Using the core digital marketing channels - SEO,
Paid Search, Display and Social Media Advertising - to create effective, successful marketing
campaigns.

## About The Implant Files

## Train. Test. Study. Repeat.

Easy to use, Versatile Lung Simulators. Ideal for teaching, training, testing and research.

[MII TTL research & development photo 2]
[View Lung Simulators][48]

## Realistic Lung Simulation You Can Trust

## Lung Simulators For Training, Testing and Research

Your simulation tools should behave like real lungs. Michigan Instruments lung simulators replicate
true pulmonary mechanics, allowing users to see and measure how ventilators and respiratory devices
respond in real time.

**Used across:**
* Respiratory therapy and clinical education
* Biomedical engineering and device testing
* Research and product development

With adult and infant configurations, plus advanced capabilities through PneuView®, our systems
support everything from foundational training to detailed analysis.

Our lung simulators replicate real pulmonary mechanics with accuracy you can see, feel and measure.
Trusted by educators, engineers and clinicians worldwide.

## CONSISTENCY WHEN EVERY SECOND COUNTS

## Automated CPR Machines Built for Real-World Response

When cardiac arrest happens, every compression matters.

Our mechanical CPR devices deliver steady, uninterrupted compressions during both in-hospital and
out-of-hospital cardiac arrest—helping reduce fatigue, eliminate variability, and support better
patient care.

**Key Advantages:**
* Consistent compression rate and depth
* Rapid deployment with minimal setup

Michigan Instruments [Life-Stat®][49] and [Thumper®][50] are designed to deliver uninterrupted
guidance-compliant compressions – so your team can focus on the rest of the patient care. Trusted in
hospitals, EMS and emergency response.

[Automated CPR Machines - 3 people.]
[View CPR][51]

## Why Michigan Instruments

We design equipment for professionals who work under pressure—where accuracy, consistency, and
reliability matter every day.

Our lung simulators and automated CPR devices are used worldwide by educators, clinicians,
engineers, and emergency responders who rely on dependable performance.

“I like that they are easy for the students to use when adjusting compliance and resistance. It is
also visual, so they can see what is happening with those changes.”

**Helen Grim, M.S., RRT, RRT-ACCS** Respiratory Care Program Coordinator, Mott Community College

“Very robust build with an intuitive software interface. Also appreciate having analog gauges as a
sanity check.”

**Joe D. Perry**Baromedical Corp.

“Easy to set lung settings such as resistance and compliance, and the ability to add the head is
great too. It will be good to simulate leaks.”

**Philippe Fernandes**L3 Medical

“Simple, robust and intuitive.”

**Martin Luchinger** University of Zurich

“Reliable, proven, universally accepted.”

##### We used to spend countless hours searching through comps to extract somewhat reliable info.

[Emmanuel Gallet]

Emmanuel Gallet

Finance Manager at Breega

##### It's about time for investment bankers get a user-friendly public comps platform that is

Silvio Bellini

Partner, Trikon Advisors

##### I like a lot the simplicity and fluidity of the Multiples platform, and the killer part is
##### really the "verticals" classification - super useful when trying to find niche tech comps.

[Victor Huberson]

Victor Huberson

Investor at Partech

01.

## Connect to Claude and other AI tools

Extract custom insights, like buyer lists or valuation sentiment, via MCP or the native AI chatbot.
Trained directly on our dataset.

[Connect to MCP][10]

Extremely useful tool. I love the sector classification, which is much more updated and relevant to
tech investors vs. other tools in the market. It saves a lot of time!

[Constanza Diaz]

Constanza Diaz

Investor at Octopus Ventures

[Connect to Claude and other AI tools]
02.

## Investment-Grade Valuation Data

You can trust the numbers. Our public comps are powered by FactSet and Morningstar, while deal data
is sourced through a proprietary investment banking research. Benchmark 50+ various metrics like
EV/NTM revenue, EV/Gross Profit, rule of 40, Bessemer's rule of X, revenue per employee, or R&D to
sales ratio.

[See more on data][11]

Extremely useful tool. I love the sector classification, which is much more updated and relevant to
tech investors vs. other tools in the market. It saves a lot of time!

[Constanza Diaz]

Constanza Diaz

Investor at Octopus Ventures

[Investment-Grade Valuation Data]
03.

## Sector Classification Built For Digital Age

We split comps into 220+ granular categories across all industry verticals, with a special emphasis
on digital ecosystems. You can filter through tech themes like vertical AI applications or IoT as
well as compare to offline sectors like airlines or logistics.

[See more on sectors][12]

Multiples is an absolute game-changer and saved me countless hours of analysis. User-friendly UI,
it's just incredibly easy to focus on metrics that matter the most.

[Adam Hajer]

Adam Hajer

Investor at Russmedia

[Sector Classification Built For Digital Age]
04.

## Automate Valuation Workflows With API

Use our white-label API to seamlessly integrate Multiples data within your existing Sheets or Excel
workflows, or build your own financial SaaS products powered by our data - significantly cheaper
(and faster!) than legacy data providers.

[See API documentation][13]

With the most comprehensive tech-first company taxonomy I've seen for public markets, Multiples.vc
allowed us to bring the data to life for the State of European Tech Report readers.

[Hanna-Stina Sonts]

Hanna-Stina Sonts

VP at Atomico

[Automate Valuation Workflows With API]

## Finding Valuation Multiples
## Doesn't Need To Be Painful

Our mission: to deliver institutional-quality valuation data through a modern UI at a fraction of
the cost of major providers.

### AI Analyst

Native AI copilot continously trained on our dataset, so you can extract custom insights in seconds.

### Consensus Estimates

Access metrics like NTM Revenue or 2027E EBITDA, powered by FactSet, harmonized by us.

### Verified Deal Data

Get M&A and VC round valuation data with over 27% more deal multiples compared to MergerMarket.

### Historical Time Series Data

Track valuation trends with 10 years of monthly historical data across all public companies.

### Connect to Claude and other AI tools

Use [MCP][14] to extract insights from our dataset without leaving Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI
tools.

### Valuations, Automated

Automate your Google Sheets and Excel valuation workflows, or build your own tools using our
[API][15].

Based On Science
Answers to everyday science and health questions

### Based On Science
* ### Are there proven treatments for Ebola?
  
  Yes. Scientists have developed treatments that improve survival for Ebola virus disease caused by
  Zaire ebolavirus, especially when patients receive care early. But treatments that work for one
  species of Ebola virus may not work against all Ebola viruses.
  
  [Read Article][57]
* ### Are contrails harmful to the environment?
  
  Some contrails can contribute to global warming. Contrails—pure ice clouds (“cirrus”) that form
  from aircraft exhaust under specific cold conditions—can trap heat in the atmosphere, sometimes
  creating as much warming as the carbon dioxide released by burning jet fuel.
  
  Read Article
* ### Can vitamin A help prevent measles?
  
  Vitamin A does not prevent measles. The most effective way to prevent measles is through
  vaccination. Vitamin A supplements are a tool in reducing complications from measles, but they
  will not prevent infection. Vitamin A, when used under the guidance of a health care provider, may
  reduce the severity of measles, particularly among children at high risk of deficiency. However,
  too much vitamin A is dangerous.
  
  [Read Article][58]

Based On Science
Answers to everyday science and health questions

### Based On Science
* ### Are there proven treatments for Ebola?
  
  Yes. Scientists have developed treatments that improve survival for Ebola virus disease caused by
  Zaire ebolavirus, especially when patients receive care early. But treatments that work for one
  species of Ebola virus may not work against all Ebola viruses.
  
  [Read Article][57]
* ### Are contrails harmful to the environment?
  
  Some contrails can contribute to global warming. Contrails—pure ice clouds (“cirrus”) that form
  from aircraft exhaust under specific cold conditions—can trap heat in the atmosphere, sometimes
  creating as much warming as the carbon dioxide released by burning jet fuel.
  
  Read Article
* ### Can vitamin A help prevent measles?
  
  Vitamin A does not prevent measles. The most effective way to prevent measles is through
  vaccination. Vitamin A supplements are a tool in reducing complications from measles, but they
  will not prevent infection. Vitamin A, when used under the guidance of a health care provider, may
  reduce the severity of measles, particularly among children at high risk of deficiency. However,
  too much vitamin A is dangerous.
  
  [Read Article][58]

The work of the private, nonprofit National Academies is grounded in the expertise of our three
academies

[

National Academy of Sciences

The National Academy of Sciences was established in 1863 by an Act of Congress, signed by President
Lincoln, as a private, nongovernmental institution to advise the government on issues related to
science and technology.

National Academy of Engineering

The National Academy of Engineering was established in 1964 under the charter of the National
Academy of Sciences to bring the practices of engineering to advising the government.

][61] [

National Academy of Medicine

The National Academy of Medicine (formerly the Institute of Medicine) was established in 1970 under
the charter of the National Academy of Sciences to advise the government on medical and health
issues.

Are the practice tests on Practice Test Geeks free?▾

Yes, all practice tests are completely free. You get instant feedback with detailed explanations for
every question, with no registration required to start practicing.

How many practice tests and questions are available?▾

Practice Test Geeks offers 206,671 practice tests with over 1,389,090 questions across 5,377
certification categories, covering professional, academic, and government exams.

What types of certification exams can I prepare for?▾

You can prepare for healthcare certifications (CNA, NCLEX, RBT), food safety (ServSafe), IT
certifications (AWS, AZ-900), standardized tests (SAT, GED, ACT), professional licenses (CDL,
Notary), and hundreds more.

Do you offer real exam simulators?▾

question count, time limits, passing scores, and domain weighting for many certifications.

a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. # Better Care. Faster.

## Through simplified communication.

[[GET STARTED]][29]

 

## What is Pulsara?

 

**Pulsara connects people when seconds matter.**

Pulsara is a secure, user-friendly app that unites the entire care team, even across different
departments or organizations. By replacing multiple phone calls, radio reports, faxes, and pagers
with one unified patient channel, Pulsara streamlines workflows, leading to reduced treatment times,
lower costs, and enhanced experiences for both patients and caregivers.

## Who Uses Pulsara?

**Everyone can use Pulsara. **

From EMS and hospital staff to urgent cares, nursing homes, testing clinics, standalone EDs, Public
Health, and even FEMA Medical Operations Coordination Cells, Pulsara connects all members of the
care team, regardless of location, organization, or position.

[who-does-pulsara-help@1200x785]
[[icon_patient-type_inline@160_bh]][30] [[icon_patient-type_inline@160_sca]][31]
[[icon_patient-type_inline@160_ecmo]][32] [[icon_patient-type_inline@160_gen]][33]
[[icon_patient-type_inline@160_obstetrics]][34] [[icon_patient-type_inline@160_pulmonary]][35]
[[icon_patient-type_inline@160_sepsis]][36] [[icon_patient-type_inline@160_stemi]][37]
[[icon_patient-type_inline@160_stroke]][38] [[icon_patient-type_inline@160_surgical]][39]
[[icon_patient-type_inline@160_tox]][40] [[icon_patient-type_inline@160_trauma]][41]

## How is Pulsara Different?

Pulsara unites **ALL care team **members within and across organizations for **ANY patient** event
and **EVERY method** of arrival.

Check out these unique features our Pulsara customers rave about:

[teams-background@1147-united-region]

#### Flexible Teams

Flexible teams and team events: Create as many teams as your organization needs, and add to them on
the fly as cases and staffing change. In the case of stroke for example, your neurologist can go on
call for multiple teams, even across multiple organizations!

[stemi-alert-hospital-team@1060]

#### Flexible Alerting

Multi-phase activation for all patient types: For any case, you have the option to alert your full
STEMI (or stroke, trauma, etc) team off the bat, or start with just the ED and add others as the
case evolves.

[hands-devices-all-modules@1100x791]

#### Transparent Scheduling

Schedule your next on and off call times so the entire team has transparency into your schedule. No
more alerts when you're supposed to be sleeping or on vacation. 

[communityparamedicine-telehealth-medic-patient-tripod-md-video@1200x630]

#### Enhanced Scope & Functionality for EMS

Pulsara provides the most robust yet flexible solution for communication and logistics. EMS teams
enjoy integration with their favorite ECG monitors, EMS-to-EMS handoff, facility-to-EMS handoff, the
ability to consult specialists, medical control or any other member of the care team, and more.

[pulsara-calling-patient-family-telemedicine@600x333]

#### Live Video Including Group Calling

Pulsara provides the highest quality live video experience, complete with optional group video
conferencing and recorded video. Coming soon: screen sharing.

[team-alerts-case-complete-feedback-stroke-gridx9@1200x630]

#### No More Fragmentation

Pulsara is your single source of truth in an otherwise fragmented system: Amidst health systems with
many different referring organizations using many different devices and data sources, Pulsara allows
your organization — and any others on the patient channel — to access all of the patient data in one
place.

## Why Pulsara?

**Miscommunication in healthcare is a deadly problem that can't be solved by connecting just one
part of the care team. **

Pulsara is the only communication network that helps facilitate and streamline care coordination
across organizations.

No other solution enables geographically dispersed care teams to assemble and interact in real time
across the care continuum through a single, centralized, and time-stamped source of truth for each
case. 

 

[gridx16-teams@800x533]

#### HIPAA-Compliant and Secure

We take privacy and security very seriously. [Pulsara is SOC2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 certified][42]
and is an approved vendor with many national health systems.

#### Entire Team United

## How is Pulsara Different?

Pulsara unites **ALL care team **members within and across organizations for **ANY patient** event
and **EVERY method** of arrival.

Check out these unique features our Pulsara customers rave about:

[teams-background@1147-united-region]

#### Flexible Teams

Flexible teams and team events: Create as many teams as your organization needs, and add to them on
the fly as cases and staffing change. In the case of stroke for example, your neurologist can go on
call for multiple teams, even across multiple organizations!

[stemi-alert-hospital-team@1060]

#### Flexible Alerting

Multi-phase activation for all patient types: For any case, you have the option to alert your full
STEMI (or stroke, trauma, etc) team off the bat, or start with just the ED and add others as the
case evolves.

[hands-devices-all-modules@1100x791]

#### Transparent Scheduling

Schedule your next on and off call times so the entire team has transparency into your schedule. No
more alerts when you're supposed to be sleeping or on vacation. 

[communityparamedicine-telehealth-medic-patient-tripod-md-video@1200x630]

#### Enhanced Scope & Functionality for EMS

Pulsara provides the most robust yet flexible solution for communication and logistics. EMS teams
enjoy integration with their favorite ECG monitors, EMS-to-EMS handoff, facility-to-EMS handoff, the
ability to consult specialists, medical control or any other member of the care team, and more.

[pulsara-calling-patient-family-telemedicine@600x333]

#### Live Video Including Group Calling

Pulsara provides the highest quality live video experience, complete with optional group video
conferencing and recorded video. Coming soon: screen sharing.

[team-alerts-case-complete-feedback-stroke-gridx9@1200x630]

#### No More Fragmentation

Pulsara is your single source of truth in an otherwise fragmented system: Amidst health systems with
many different referring organizations using many different devices and data sources, Pulsara allows
your organization — and any others on the patient channel — to access all of the patient data in one
place.

## Why Pulsara?

**Miscommunication in healthcare is a deadly problem that can't be solved by connecting just one
part of the care team. **

Pulsara is the only communication network that helps facilitate and streamline care coordination
across organizations.

No other solution enables geographically dispersed care teams to assemble and interact in real time
across the care continuum through a single, centralized, and time-stamped source of truth for each
case. 

 

[gridx16-teams@800x533]

#### HIPAA-Compliant and Secure

We take privacy and security very seriously. [Pulsara is SOC2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 certified][42]
and is an approved vendor with many national health systems.

#### Entire Team United

Regardless of a clinician's location or organization, everyone who is part of the care team can
communicate on ONE patient channel.

#### Flexible and Scalable 

From the routine transport to a worldwide pandemic, Pulsara easily adapts to fit the ever-changing
needs and resources.

#### Build Teams on the Fly

As the case evolves, easily add resources with simple tap - even from a different department,
hospital or healthcare organization.

#### Faster Treatment, Lower Costs

Eliminating miscommunication translates to faster treatment times, reduced costs, and improved
outcomes for patients.

#### [Award-Winning Support][43]

We walk alongside you every step of the way, from implementation to ongoing support. Think of us as
an extension of your team!

## What Does the Data Say? 

Pulsara is trusted by leading health systems across the United States and Australia. 100% of our
clients report better treatment times after using Pulsara.

in door-to-needle time for stroke patients. [See the full research poster here. ][45]

meet the door-to-needle < 60 minutes goal in stroke care. [Read the case study here. ][51]

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

**Treaton — Advanced Medical Technology • Reliable Performance • Professional Support • 35 Years of
Excellence**

# Your CDMO specialized in ex vivo and in vivo lentiviral vectors

## Making the medicine of the future a reality

[ Our services ][41]

## With expertise in virology, we tailor solutions to meet specific requirements of your lentiviral
## vector for both ex vivo and in vivo administration.

### Business model

GMP CDMO focused on different stages of the process.

### Specialization

We work exclusively in lentivirus, offering comprehensive services.

### Customized service

Technical adaptation and timely slot availability for each project.

### Quality and regulatory

Compliance with EMA and FDA regulatory requirements.
